jobs.description: Reference code: JR133383 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. “Do you enjoy orchestrating evolutions towards operational efficiency and future-ready customer and employee experiences? Are you eager to use the latest technologies and participate to the build of constantly improving solutions? If yes, then apply and join us. A team aiming at accelerating business through technology is waiting for you to step up and have an impact on our Group transformation” YOUR MISSION: As part of the Group Platforms department, Richemont is looking to strengthen a very dynamic Product Management team. This Product team is structured around key capabilities that support our Maisons’ value chain strategy. The Product Development Product Owner will be the interface between the Group Maisons, Central Functions, other Product teams and the technical teams delivering the solutions supporting the business needs related to product development within the product organization framework. He/She will ensure the proper capture of product development related needs (evolution, enrichment, cutover support, etc.), perform the discovery and analysis along technical teams of the requirements, prioritize the requests based on their business value, opportunities and time criticality. He/she will ensure the delivery of those requests by technical teams following an agile framework, working closely with Group Technology counterparts forming the Product & Process Development Product Team. Working alongside other Product owners, he/she will facilitate the coordination of other Product teams and their Product Development related needs. He/she will also lead or support initiatives to increase the maturity level on product development flow, from harmonization of rules and practices to the deployment of new tools and processes. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will maintain and refine product backlog based on changing needs according to business value or ROI, given capacity available. You will partner with the Technology teams to make sure the product vision is translated appropriately into the implementation. You will align with cross-functional teams to manage cross-product dependencies. You will work with the Product Team to ensure selected technologies match business requirements expressed by business stakeholders (Maisons, Functions, Regions/countries) You will be responsible for product adoption, delivering product training support, and documents. You will support business performing change management and sharing best practices. You will conduct regular updates to share how the product is evolving and to demonstrate how it contributes to the business vision and to the success of Richemont and its Maisons. You will continuously seek to improve products to meet Business outcomes, tracking user feedback, benefits, adoption and usage through key metrics / KPIs. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Excellence is a top priority for our teams. On this role you have the occasion to play a pivotal role in the development of the Group core operations. Your passion for moving forward and achieving will find the perfect context within the team. Innovation is at the heart of what we do, joining us means being exposed to latest trends and technologies. DIMENSIONS 5-10 years’ experience in product development, with a strong background in CAD methodologies—ideally utilizing PTC Creo within a Manufacturing environment. Proven experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, ideally PTC Windchill (including CAD data management, Bill of Materials (BOM) management, and engineering change processes). Strong understanding of CAD/PLM integration and how product data flows from design to manufacturing. Master’s degree in business administration, engineering, or equivalent qualifications. Excellent Business acumen, strong customer orientation Successful experience in facilitation, change management, and cross-business areas problem solving Knowledge of collaborative solutions for product management and Agile frameworks/methodologies. Experience in implementing PO techniques (e.g., customer journeys, personas, discovery, agile ceremonies). Ability to anticipate change through technologies. Strong analytical, problem-solving, negotiation and organizational skills. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, good listener. Ability to present complex technical concepts (CAD/PLM) in a user-friendly or executive language at different management levels up to C-Level, motivate and inspire teams with client vision. Experience working in a team-oriented and collaborative environment. Proficiency in English is mandatory. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Product Manager - Customer Relations Centers (CRCs) Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont Finance Senior Product Owner Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont QA Development Lead Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133383 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. “Ti piace orchestrare le evoluzioni verso l’efficienza operativa e le esperienze future dei clienti e dei dipendenti? Sei impaziente di utilizzare le ultime tecnologie e partecipare alla costruzione di soluzioni in costante miglioramento? Se sì, allora applicare e unirsi a noi. Un team che mira ad accelerare il business attraverso la tecnologia vi aspetta per salire e avere un impatto sulla nostra trasformazione del Gruppo” TUA MISSIONE: Nell’ambito del dipartimento Piattaforme di Gruppo, Richemont sta cercando di rafforzare un team di gestione del prodotto molto dinamico. Questo team di prodotti è strutturato attorno a funzionalità chiave che supportano la strategia della catena del valore delle nostre Maison. Il Product Development Product Owner sarà l'interfaccia tra le Maison del Gruppo, le Funzioni Centrali, altri team di Prodotto e i team tecnici che forniscono le soluzioni che supportano le esigenze aziendali legate allo sviluppo del prodotto nell'ambito dell'organizzazione del prodotto. Si assicurerà la corretta acquisizione delle esigenze relative allo sviluppo del prodotto (evoluzione, arricchimento, supporto di taglio, ecc.), eseguire la scoperta e l'analisi lungo i team tecnici delle esigenze, priorità le richieste in base al loro valore aziendale, opportunità e criticità del tempo. Si assicurerà la consegna di tali richieste da parte di team tecnici a seguito di un quadro agile, lavorando a stretto contatto con le controparti di Group Technology che formano il Product & Process Development Product Team. Lavorando insieme ad altri proprietari di prodotti, faciliterà il coordinamento di altri team di prodotto e le loro esigenze relative allo sviluppo del prodotto. This Product team is structured around key capabilities that support our Maisons’ value chain strategy. He/she will ensure the delivery of those requests by technical teams following an agile framework, working closely with Group Technology counterparts forming the Product & Process Development Product Team. He/she will also lead or support initiatives to increase the maturity level on product development flow, from harmonization of rules and practices to the deployment of new tools and processes. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will maintain and refine product backlog based on changing needs according to business value or ROI, given capacity available. You will partner with the Technology teams to make sure the product vision is translated appropriately into the implementation. You will align with cross-functional teams to manage cross-product dependencies. You will work with the Product Team to ensure selected technologies match business requirements expressed by business stakeholders (Maisons, Functions, Regions/countries) You will be responsible for product adoption, delivering product training support, and documents. You will support business performing change management and sharing best practices. You will conduct regular updates to share how the product is evolving and to demonstrate how it contributes to the business vision and to the success of Richemont and its Maisons. You will continuously seek to improve products to meet Business outcomes, tracking user feedback, benefits, adoption and usage through key metrics / KPIs. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Excellence is a top priority for our teams. On this role you have the occasion to play a pivotal role in the development of the Group core operations. Your passion for moving forward and achieving will find the perfect context within the team. Innovation is at the heart of what we do, joining us means being exposed to latest trends and technologies. Proven experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, ideally PTC Windchill (including CAD data management, Bill of Materials (BOM) management, and engineering change processes). Strong understanding of CAD/PLM integration and how product data flows from design to manufacturing. Master’s degree in business administration, engineering, or equivalent qualifications. Experience working in a team-oriented and collaborative environment. jobs.title: Assistant Boutique Manager
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133372 Since the legend's reincarnation in 1994, A. Lange & Söhne has been one of the most respected and successful watch brands in the luxury sector. Our whole aim is to continue our tradition with new, outstanding products, very much in keeping with Lange's claim: State-of-the-art tradition. What we expect from our watches, we expect from us: Never stand still. PURPOSE Managing day-to-day boutique operations, transforming corporate objectives into operational goals at a boutique level. Being the brand ambassador to reflect brand image to boutique customers. Attain desired results through creative and effective use of resources, retail and CRM tools. Prepare business analysis and action plans to achieve sales targets. Assist the boutique manager in his/her role. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES SALES Meet personal budgets in accordance with brand retail strategy (compliance with group procedures, legal, fiscal, and customs regulations). Maximize profit whist controlling & minimizing costs (discount, general expenses, third party commissions). Regularly analyze and question missed confirmed sales with Assistant/Boutique Manager, to further refine future sales projections. Organize private viewing with potential VIPs in your region. Discuss business opportunities/Action Plans of potential prospects with Assistant/Boutique Manager. Act as a reference in terms of building action plans to achieve personal targets. Assist boutique manager in exceeding boutique budgets in accordance with brand retail strategy (compliance with group procedures, legal, fiscal, and customs regulations). Achieve Boutique KPIs defined by Boutique Manager and/or regional brand manager. Learn and support the boutique manager with implementing HQ commercial guidelines (Retail Manual). Support the preparation and delivery of monthly boutique meetings and follow-up actions. Analyze each boutique visit with concerned sales member and build action plan to for possible conversion/retention. TEAM MANAGEMENT Act as a manager-on-duty when the boutique manager is absent Identify and share with the boutique manager the training needs of boutique members. Ensure monthly staff programs are planned and communicated to boutique manager. Responsible for supporting the boutique manager in integrating and training new and existing team members. Monitor staff appearances and behavior, in line with company policy and boutique guidelines (uniform, makeup, language, hair, accessories, etc). Provide support to boutique manager in coaching of each boutique member and collective objectives, via (not limited to) team meetings, on the job trainings, assignment of tasks, and feedback on expectations. Organize boutique team schedules and solve conflicts, to ensure work equality of staff in terms of working hours and opportunities. STORE MANAGEMENT Ensure Excellence in at outside of the boutique. Ensure maximum client welcoming, handling, and servicing. Demonstrate brand ambassadorial skills, at any given time, with partners or local dignitaries. Responsible for overall appearance and maintenance of the boutique in accordance to brand guidelines and concept. Assist in timely boutique implementation and control of any new Visual Merchandizing concepts. STORE OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT Learn and practice compliance with Group and Brand (Retail Manual) procedures. Act as a manager-on-duty when the boutique manager is absent. Actively ensure accuracy of monthly (quarterly, yearly) stocktaking and quality control. Actively ensuring all measures to avoid stock discrepancies at all times. Ensuring maintenance of all boutique timepieces when necessary: changing of straps polishing, servicing, etc. Weekly follow up with regional head office for stock replenishments and active order requests. FINANCIAL & CASH REGISTER CONTROL Compliance with procedures, and with legal, fiscal and customs regulations. Control cash register. REPORTING Ensure timely reporting of sales (daily, monthly) in accordance with boutique brand and sales manager. Identify strengths and weaknesses in existing operation to define action plans for implementation. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE & CRM RELATED ACTIVITIES Support and ensure the boutique team confidently delivers Lange selling ceremony. Be part of a positive atmosphere within the boutique; optimistic, constructive, helpful, confident, etc. Proactively participate in VIP events and orders, be considerate of our boutique opportunities. Ensure accurate and genuine relationship building with customers. Ensure attention to existing and new recruitment of VIP, customer and prospect database for boutique sales and marketing activities. Individually handle with care client complaints, and immediately report to Assistant/Boutique Manager brand product related issues. Follow up and coordinate individual repairs and after sales related matters with Sales Administrators. WHAT WE OFFER An attractive compensation and benefits program A small, dynamic, and caring team A role with a wide range of tasks and responsibilities A work environment where we value collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity Continuous learning and development opportunities Similar Jobs Assistant Boutique Manager Save Sydney, Australia A. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133372 Sin dalla reincarnazione della leggenda nel 1994, A. Lange & Söhne è stato uno dei marchi di orologi più rispettati e di successo nel settore del lusso. Tutto il nostro amore è quello di continuare la nostra tradizione con nuovi prodotti eccezionali, molto in linea con la pretesa di Lange: la tradizione all'avanguardia. Quello che ci aspettiamo dai nostri orologi, ci aspettiamo da noi: Mai stare fermo. Responsabile per il supporto al direttore della boutique nell'integrazione e nella formazione di nuovi e già esistenti membri del team. Monitorare le apparizioni e i comportamenti del personale, in linea con la politica aziendale e le linee guida di boutique (uniform, makeup, lingua, capelli, accessori, ecc.). Fornire supporto a manager boutique in coaching di ogni membro boutique e obiettivi collettivi, tramite (non limitato a) incontri di squadra, sulle formazioni di lavoro, assegnazione di Compiti e feedback sulle aspettative. Organizzazione team di boutique orari e risolvere i conflitti, per garantire la parità di lavoro del personale in termini di ore di lavoro e opportunità. Reference code: JR133422 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? We are seeking a dynamic and experienced HR Business Partner to join our Cartier Switzerland team. This pivotal role will position you as a partner for our boutiques and Retail leadership, actively contributing to the definition and execution of our HR strategy in service of Cartier’s commercial success. Key 
• Responsibilities: Partnership & Expert Advice: Act as a trusted HR advisor and partner to Retail leadership, translating business priorities into concrete and effective HR initiatives. Provide expert guidance on all HR matters, including Swiss labor law, talent acquisition, HR policies, performance management, and skills development. Talent Lifecycle Management: Drive the entire talent lifecycle for our boutique employees, including recruitment, performance management, talent reviews and development, salary review processes, and succession planning, to strengthen our Retail teams' capabilities and enhance retention. Data-Driven HR & Operations: Utilize HR Information Systems (such as Workday and SAP) to optimize processes and adopt an analytical approach to interpret HR data. Provide data-driven recommendations to improve HR effectiveness and contribute to business outcomes, including budget planning and headcount control. Cultural Leadership & Change Management: Promote a performance-driven, diverse, and inclusive culture within Cartier. Lead and implement local and international HR projects, driving and executing impactful HR change management initiatives across the boutique network. Boutique Proximity & Collaboration: Ensure strong proximity and close collaboration with our boutique teams, involving regular travel across Switzerland (minimum 30%) to understand their needs and provide on-the-ground support. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in a HRBP role. Demonstrated experience within the luxury industry, with a strong understanding of the retail environment being a significant asset. Proven ability to effectively manage diverse stakeholders and build strong relationships in a multicultural setting. Proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), including Workday and SAP, coupled with advanced Excel skills. A detail-oriented approach combined with a strong drive for results. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively. In-depth knowledge and practical application of Swiss labor law. Fluency in both French and English is essential; proficiency in German or Italian is a distinct advantage. Ability to travel up to 30 % of the time Still wondering why, you should apply? You will join a friendly and dynamic team with whom you will be able to share your knowledge and expertise Entrepreneurship, trust, integrity and agile learning are part of our great team spirit You will interact with numerous stakeholders across Maisons, Functions WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity We care for the world we live in. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Salesforce Business Analyst - B2B/ Wholesale Save Moscavide, Portugal Richemont Revenue Growth & Performance Project Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Panerai Workforce Management (WFM) Specialist - Fixed Term Contract Save Sydney, Australia Richemont

Codice di riferimento: JR133422 Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont sembra preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell'innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con le nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Come fai a fare un'infezione? Stiamo vedendo un partner aziendale HR dinamico ed esperto per unirsi al nostro team Cartier Svizzera. Questo ruolo fondamentale vi posiziona come partner per le nostre boutique e la nostra leadership al dettaglio, contribuendo attivamente alla definizione e all'esecuzione della nostra strategia HR al servizio di Cartier Key
• Responsabilità: Partnership & Expert Advice: Act as a trust HR advisor and partner to Retail leadership, traducendo le priorità aziendali in iniziative HR concrete ed efficaci. Fornire una guida esperta su tutte le questioni HR, tra cui diritto del lavoro svizzero, talento di acquisizione, politiche HR, gestione delle prestazioni e sviluppo delle competenze. Talent Lifecycle Management: guidare l'intero ciclo di vita del talento per i nostri dipendenti boutique, tra cui il reclutamento, la gestione delle prestazioni, le recensioni dei talenti e lo sviluppo, i processi di revisione salariale e la pianificazione di successione, per rafforzare le capacità dei nostri team di vendita al dettaglio e il resonant di valorizzazione. Data-Driven HR & Operations: Utilizzare sistemi informativi HR (come Workday e SAP) per ottimizzare i processi e adottare un approccio analitico per interpretare i dati HR. Fornire raccomandazioni basate sui dati per migliorare l'efficacia delle risorse umane e contribuire ai risultati aziendali, compresa la pianificazione del budget e il controllo dei conti. Leadership culturale & Change Management: Promuovere una cultura orientata alle prestazioni, diversificata e inclusiva all'interno di Cartier. Guidare e implementare progetti HR locali e internazionali, guidare e implementare iniziative di gestione dei cambiamenti HR impattanti in tutta la rete boutique. Proximity & Collaboration: Garantire una forte prossimità e una stretta collaborazione con i nostri team di boutique, coinvolgendo regolarmente i viaggi in tutta la Svizzera (minimo 30%) per capire le loro esigenze e fornire supporto on-the-ground. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Un minimo di 3 a 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo HRBP. Esperienza dimostrata all'interno del settore del lusso, con una forte comprensione dell'ambiente di dettaglio essendo un bene significativo. Prove capacità di gestire efficacemente vari negozi e costruire relazioni forti in un ambiente multiculturale. Proficienza nei sistemi di informazione HR (HRIS), tra cui Workday e SAP, insieme alle competenze avanzate di Excel. Un approccio dettagliato, combinato con una forte spinta per i risultati. Comunicazione eccezionale e competenze interpersonali, con una comprovata capacità di influenzare e collaborare efficacemente. Conoscenza approfondita e applicazione pratica del diritto del lavoro svizzero. La fluidità sia in francese che in inglese è essenziale; la facoltà in tedesco o in italiano è un vantaggio distinto. Capacità di viaggiare fino al 30% del tempo Ancora vincendo perché, si dovrebbe applicare? Ti unirai a un team amichevole e dinamico con il quale sarai in grado di condividere le tue conoscenze e competenze Imprenditorialità, fiducia, integrità e apprendimento agile fanno parte del nostro grande spirito di squadra Interagirete con le parti interessate digitali attraverso le Case, le Funzioni CHE MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra speciale capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Apprezziamo la libertà, la collegialità, la fedeltà e la solidarietà Noi adottiamo l'empatia, la curiosità, il coraggio, l'umiliazione e l'integrità Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Group HR Reporting Manager Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Revenue Growth & Performance Project Manager Save Meyrin, Svizzera Panerai Swiss Talent Acquisition Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Svizzera Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR133496 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. WE WELCOME We are looking for a talented Sales Associate (12-month contract) who wants to join one of the legendary boutique, Cartier Zürich, and contribute to the success and growth of one of our main boutiques. YOU WILL BE An Ambassador of Cartier and will become your second nature in the Boutique and at external Client events. You will have the mission to deliver an outstanding service to high value guests while making them feel at home in our Boutique. By proactively building a strong relationship with your Client’s portfolio, you will guide them across our Creations to deliver unique Client experience. Thanks to your team spirit, working towards individual targets as well as making a key difference to the shared team objectives will be your two main goals. Your contribution will be key to a seamless and smooth running of the Boutique operations. The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you. YOU ARE Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your Clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from. If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you speak fluently English & German and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you! APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR! jobs.description: Reference code: JR133485 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Missions Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 4 ans pour obtenir votre Certificat Fédéral de Capacité de Polymécanicien·ne. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de la mécanique, en fonction des activités et des opportunités de formation. Pendant cette formation, vous apprendrez à fabriquer des pièces précises, uniques ou en prototype. Vous utiliserez des machines conventionnelles et des machines CNC (à commandes numériques). Vous développerez des compétences en programmation de ces machines, et la maîtrise de différentes techniques (exemple : d'érosion à fil ou par plongée). Responsabilités Réaliser des assemblages mécaniques complets Réaliser des opérations d’usinage sur machines conventionnelles et CNC Programmer et utiliser des machines CNC Contrôler la qualité des pièces produites Identifier et analyser les éventuels défauts Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus de production Collaborer avec les différents métiers et départements CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Bon niveau de français à l'oral comme à l'écrit permettant de réussir sa formation professionnelle Bonnes aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques Intérêt, curiosité et motivation pour la mécanique de précision, la technique et l'horlogerie (une expérience de stage dans ce domaine serait un atout) Dextérité manuelle, minutie et souci du détail Autonomie, rigueur et proactivité Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Si vous êtes motivé·e, nous avons hâte de découvrir votre dossier de candidature complet, qui sera étudié par nos équipes recrutement et formation. Par la suite, vous aurez un entretien individuel avec un membre de notre équipe RH et le Responsable de la formation et réaliserez des tests théoriques et pratiques. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133449 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. The mission of the Responsible Sourcing Hard Luxury Project Manager is to support the expert in the suppliers & raw materials responsible sourcing performance monitoring and continuous improvement. You will participate in the steady development of the diamonds and coloured gemstones risk mapping. You will also follow-up on the continuous evaluation of suppliers and subcontractors along the supply chain and formalize all due diligence related information. In a fast evolving ESG regulations context, this role will also contribute to the definition of new quantitative indicators, building a resilient Responsible Sourcing management system. The scope of the mission will encompass all Richemont Maisons sourcing and/or producing finished products with diamonds and coloured gemstones. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Maintain an accurate, reliable diamonds and coloured gemstones supply chain database and KPI’s Maintain and continuously improve the supply chain database including all due diligence related information. Prepare and follow-up on a regular basis the diamonds and coloured gemstones Responsible Sourcing key performance indicators - KPI’s Participate in the definition of new Responsible Sourcing KPI’s Engage in the different data digitalisation initiatives of the department Ensure data security and confidentiality Coordinate supplier naturality and traceability audits and follow-ups In collaboration with the expert and the Maisons, prepare the audit campaigns Follow-up with Maisons and ensure audit plan execution Provide and formalize regular status update and escalate if needed Participate in the animation of Group Diamonds & Coloured gemstones community Support the Head of Responsible Sourcing Hard Luxury in the preparation of the different Committees and internal and external working groups Preparation of minute meetings Other transversal related tasks Contribute to the Group ESG reporting Collaborate with the team responsible for emission factors related topics HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience, preferably in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Compliance, or Sustainability related discipline. Minimum 2-4 years’ experience in Procurement or within the Sustainability area with a strong interest in Responsible Sourcing topics An experience in the field of the precious materials is a plus Knowledge & Skills Integrity, Discretion & Confidentiality Professional communications skills both verbally and in writing with mandatory fluency in French and English Data oriented Proficient in MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Word), Power Bi SAP Knowledge is a plus WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? descriptionByLocale.de:
Bezugscode: JR133449 Richemont besitzt einige der weltweit führenden Luxusgüter Maisons, mit besonderen Stärken in Schmuck, feinen Uhren und Premium-Accessoires. Jede Maison steht für eine stolze Tradition von Stil, Qualität und Handwerkskunst und Richemont ist bestrebt, das Erbe und die Identität jeder seiner Maisons zu bewahren. Gleichzeitig engagieren wir uns für Innovationen und die Entwicklung neuer Produkte, die den Werten unserer Maisons entsprechen, durch einen Prozess der kontinuierlichen Kreativität. Die Mission des Responsible Sourcing Hard Luxury Projektmanagers ist es, den Experten für die Überwachung der Lieferanten- und Rohstoff-Verantwortlichkeit der Beschaffung und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu unterstützen. Sie werden an der stetigen Entwicklung der Diamanten und farbigen Edelsteine Risikokartierung teilnehmen. Sie werden auch die kontinuierliche Bewertung von Lieferanten und Subunternehmern entlang der Lieferkette verfolgen und alle Informationen zur Sorgfaltspflicht formalisieren. In einem sich schnell entwickelnden Kontext der ESG-Vorschriften wird diese Rolle auch zur Definition neuer quantitativer Indikatoren beitragen und ein widerstandsfähiges Managementsystem für verantwortungsvolle Beschaffung aufbauen. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133439 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. VOTRE MISSION Assurer l'atteinte des objectifs de qualité, de délais, de coût, de sûreté et de sécurité en gérant son équipe et les moyens techniques utilisés. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. A travers son histoire, Cartier s'est démarqué du fait de l'engagement de femmes et d'hommes singuliers. A ce titre, notre Maison offre à toutes et tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Assurer le management de votre équipe Vous organisez de façon optimale votre département, vous recrutez les bons profils, vous évaluez et vous valorisez la performance et vous développez les potentiels et l'expertise pour les fédérer et les retenir. Vous êtes un relais de communication auprès de vos collaborateurs et vous promouvez les valeurs de la Maison. Vous êtes le moteur de l'amélioration continue en animant les rituels et garantissant la méthodologie, tout en adoptant une posture de coach pour identifier et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'optimisation de la performance. Vous incarnez les valeurs de l'entreprise et vous en êtes le premier ambassadeur sur le terrain, inspirant votre équipe à les adopter et à les promouvoir dans votre environnement de travail. Vous gérez les conflits et vous contribuez à développer une ambiance de travail saine et stimulante. Vous contribuez et vous faites contribuer activement à la démarche de l’environnement durable de la Maison. Responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs de votre secteur en terme de coût, qualité, délai et sécurité Vous assurez le maintien des processus et des moyens existants et vous participez à la mise en place des nouveaux processus de fabrication. Vous participez à la construction du planning d’ordonnancement. Vous gérez l’approvisionnement et les stocks de consommables de votre secteur, tout en maîtrisant le budget alloué. Vous veillez au partage des informations auprès des différents partenaires et de votre équipe. Vous assurez le suivi de la production de votre secteur à l’aide des outils digitaux et vous préparez les rapports de votre secteur. Vous êtes force de proposition pour améliorer la production (ergonomie, flux, méthode, outils, qualité). Etre garant de la conformité des processus de fabrication et de la qualité des pièces Vous êtes garant de la conformité des processus de fabrication et de la qualité des pièces. Vous êtes garant du respect des processus. Vous entreprenez les actions correctives en partenariat avec les départements supports. Vous pilotez les audits Produits/Process de votre secteur en partenariat avec l’équipe qualité. Vous êtes garant du respect des procédures de sûreté et sécurité QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Titulaire d’un diplôme d’études supérieures et avec une expérience confirmée dans un poste similaire idéalement au sein d’un environnement industriel, vous avez une bonne connaissance des processus de production industriels et/ou un fort intérêt pour les produits joailliers. Doté d’une vision pragmatique et globale de votre environnement, vous êtes capable d’appréhender aisément des problématiques transverses, à la fois techniques et managériales, et d’animer vos équipes de production avec rigueur, empathie et bienveillance. Vous êtes autonome et aimez assumer des responsabilités dans un environnement exigeant. A l’aise avec les chiffres, les outils digitaux usuels et bon communicant, vous êtes capable de rendre compte de manière régulière de l’atteinte de vos résultats opérationnels avec rigueur et proactivité. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133491 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. SPECIALISTE ASSURANCE QUALITE FOURNISSEURS (H/F) Plan-les-Ouates Contrat CDD POUR CEUX ET CELLES QUI RECHERCHENT L’EXCELLENCE Rejoignez l’une des Maisons emblématiques de la haute horlogerie, où l’excellence est une exigence constante. Prenez part à notre succès collectif et à la création de notre héritage futur. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON Vous êtes attiré(e) par un poste de Technicien Qualité polyvalent et bénéficiez d’une expérience réussie dans ce domaine, cette opportunité peut répondre à vos aspirations ! VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER Animer la performance qualité auprès de nos partenaires : Vous serez le maillon clé pour assurer le déploiement de la démarche Qualité Vacheron Constantin et garantir la diffusion de nos exigences auprès des fournisseurs. Garantir la conformité des produits achetés : De la phase du premier prototype jusqu'à la vie série, vous veillerez à la conformité de nos produits. Créer et optimiser les plans de contrôles réception. Apporter un support aux ateliers de production lors de difficultés liées aux composants achetés. Piloter, suivre et valider les plans d'actions concernant les non-conformités fournisseurs ou les plans de progression fournisseur. Vous vérifierez leur pertinence et leur mise en œuvre. Mener les audits qualité produits et process auprès de nos fournisseurs. LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER : La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur : Une formation type Ingénieur en Mécanique et/ou qualité. Votre motivation pour un rôle riche au sein d’une équipe Assurance Qualité Fournisseurs dynamique et en développement. Votre autonomie dans les décisions stratégiques Votre aisance avec les moyens de mesures, les méthodes de résolutions de problème, les outils qualité, la gestion de projets, les processus de fabrication et idéalement le domaine horloger. Votre excellente capacité à faciliter la communication avec les équipes internes et les fournisseurs. Votre grande aisance avec les logiciels de bureautique. Votre excellente maîtrise du français et bonnes capacités en anglais. Votre expérience en tant que technicien/ne qualité au sein d'une manufacture horlogère serait un réel atout. Vacheron Constantin a célébré 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. Ihre hervorragende Fähigkeit, die Kommunikation mit internen Teams und Lieferanten zu erleichtern. Ihre große Leichtigkeit mit Office-Software. Ihre hervorragende Beherrschung von Französisch und gute Englischkenntnisse. Ihre Erfahrung als Qualitätstechniker in einer Uhrenfabrik wäre ein echter Gewinn. Vacheron Constantin feierte 270 Jahre als älteste Uhrenfabrik der Welt, die seit 1755 ununterbrochen in Betrieb ist. Mit Sitz in Genf, Schweiz, betreibt unser Haus ein weltweites Netzwerk von fast 200 Filialen in 36 Ländern. Jedes Mitglied unserer außergewöhnlichen Gemeinschaft - Uhrmacher, Handwerker und Profis - teilt die gleiche Leidenschaft für unser Erbe und den Ehrgeiz, eine noch bessere Zukunft aufzubauen. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133517 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. CLIENT DATA & INSIGHTS MANAGER CDI Plan-les-Ouates FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE Join one of the most respected Maisons in fine watchmaking where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE We are seeking a Client Data & Insights Manager who is responsible for driving the global client engagement strategy through rigorous data governance, disciplined performance monitoring and cross-functional collaboration. This role ensures that client data is transformed into actionable insights to support business growth, client development, and CRM excellence across markets. PLAYING YOUR PART Client Data Management You will track and analyze key KPIs to monitor performance across markets and support client engagement growth You will translate business insights into data-driven action plans You will support markets in implementing client development strategies based on insights You will develop and maintain dashboards to ensure clear data performance visibility tailored for retail teams and top management You will supervise client segmentation and scoring methodologies You will ensure the highest standards of data governance and compliance You will support retail teams in embedding a strong client data culture Database Quality & Targeting You will Ensure a healthy, compliant, and actionable client database at all times You will monitor data quality, completeness, and enrichment across markets You will drive continuous improvement in targeting accuracy You will ensure relevant targeting strategies for campaigns, in close collration with the client team You will support retail teams in embedding a strong client data culture Client Performance Governance You will manage and track requests through a centralized ticketing system You will ensure proper prioritization and resolution of data, CRM, and reporting requests You will standardize KPI frameworks and reporting methodologies You will strengthen executive visibility on client performance globally Group Interface & Cross-functional Collaboration You will act as key contact for client data topics with the Group You will ensure alignment with Group frameworks, tools, and reporting standards You will collaborate closely with Regions, Marketing, Retail, Commercial, CS and key maison stakeholders to fuel business growth You will promote best practice sharing across markets WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Success in this role will require: A solid experience in client analytics, CRM, or data-driven environments An expertise in CRM ecosystems (Salesforce, a plus) and understanding of database management and data quality principles Ability to operate in a complex, international matrix organization, with a high level of precision and business acumen Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex insights effectively Solution approach and client-centric mindset with attention to detail Adaptability and agility, Collaborative and Team spirit Fluency in English and French Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133524 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. At Richemont, we craft the future. Our unique portfolio includes prestigious Maisons distinguished by their craftsmanship and creativity, alongside Online Distributors that cultivate expert curation and technological innovation to deliver the highest standards of service. Richemont’s ambition is to nurture its Maisons and businesses and enable them to grow and prosper in a responsible, sustainable manner over the long term. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES The Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) Department, supports the Group in the execution of key corporate development projects, including, among others, joint ventures, equity transactions, acquisitions, mergers and disposals, as well as related post-merger integration processes. We are looking for a highly motivated individual to fill a 6-month internship position with start date 04.01.2027. In line with this, your responsibilities would include: Support the M&A team in the review of potential investment opportunities: preparation of company profiles as well as investment memos to inform go/no-go decisions Assist the M&A team in financial and valuation analysis depending on deal type and stage of target’s development Assist in the management of key M&A and integration projects (organisation of key meetings, preparation of related materials and analysis, etc.) Contribute to the consolidation and management of the proprietary intelligence resources, including regular updates of transaction and trading comparable multiples Monitor relevant M&A news, market insights or competitors updates in the luxury goods space, preparing relevant alerts and updates for the management Attend relevant meetings, take minutes and ensure that follow-up actions are completed SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE You are a Master’s student in a Business school or university, with a specialisation in Finance, Business Administration or Management (minimum GPA 3.65/4 or equivalent) You have strong analytical and numerical skills, including some knowledge of corporate finance and valuation You are highly motivated and proactive with excellent communication skills You are a team player You are rigorous, reliable and pay attention to details You have some knowledge and a strong interest in the luxury goods industry You are proficient in Microsoft office programs You are fluent in English Previous internship experience in finance to be considered a strong plus Highly discreet - absolute trust and confidentiality required Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory YOUR JOURNEY WITH US: If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Fashion & Accessories Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Watches & Jewelry Manufacturing Project Controller - Fixed-Term (6 months) Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. A Richemont, costruiamo il futuro. Il nostro portafoglio unico comprende prestigiose Maisons contraddistinte dalla loro artigianalità e creatività, insieme a Distributori Online che coltivano la cura esperta e l'innovazione tecnologica per offrire i più elevati standard di servizio. L’ambizione di Richemont è quella di coltivare le sue Maison e le sue imprese e permettere loro di crescere e prosperare in modo responsabile e sostenibile a lungo termine. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR133524 Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux produits de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. À Richemont, nous façonnons l'avenir. Notre portefeuille unique comprend de prestigieuses Maisons distinguées par leur savoir-faire et leur créativité, aux côtés de Distributeurs en ligne qui cultivent l'expertise et l'innovation technologique pour offrir les plus hauts standards de service. L'ambition de Richemont est de nourrir ses Maisons et ses entreprises et de leur permettre de croître et de prospérer de manière responsable et durable à long terme. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS Le Département des fusions et acquisitions (M&A) appuie le Groupe dans l'exécution de grands projets de développement de l'entreprise, notamment les coentreprises, les opérations de capitaux propres, les acquisitions, les fusions et les cessions, ainsi que les processus connexes d'intégration après fusion. Nous recherchons une personne très motivée pour combler un poste de stage de 6 mois avec date de début 04.01.2027. Conformément à ce qui précède, vos responsabilités comprendraient les suivantes : Appuyer l'équipe de M&A dans l'examen des possibilités d'investissement : établissement de profils d'entreprise ainsi que de notes d'investissement pour éclairer les décisions de go/no-go Aider l'équipe de M&A dans l'analyse financière et d'évaluation selon le type de transaction et le stade de développement de la cible Aider à la gestion des projets clés de M&A et d'intégration (organisation de réunions clés, préparation de documents connexes et d'analyse, etc.) Contribuer à la consolidation et à la gestion des ressources de renseignements exclusifs, y compris les mises à jour régulières des multiples de transactions et de transactions comparables Surveiller les nouvelles pertinentes en matière de fusions-acquisitions, les perspectives du marché ou les mises à jour des concurrents dans l'espace des biens de luxe, préparer les alertes et les mises à jour pertinentes pour la direction Assister aux réunions pertinentes, prendre des minutes et s'assurer que les mesures de suivi sont terminées. Vous êtes un étudiant de maîtrise dans une école ou une université de commerce, avec une spécialisation en finance, administration des affaires ou gestion (minimum GPA 3.65/4 ou équivalent) Vous avez de solides compétences analytiques et numériques, y compris une certaine connaissance du financement d'entreprise et de l'évaluation Vous êtes très motivé et proactif avec d'excellentes compétences en communication Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe Vous êtes rigoureux, fiable et prêtez attention aux détails Vous avez quelques connaissances et un fort intérêt dans l'industrie des biens de luxe Vous êtes compétent dans les programmes de bureau Microsoft Vous maîtrisez couramment l'anglais Expérience de stage précédente en finance pour être considéré comme un fort et très discret - confiance absolue et confidentialité requise Accord de stage avec votre école / université obligatoire VOTRE JOURNÉE AVEC NOUS: Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, nous contacterons sous peu pour un appel d'introduction. jobs.description: Reference code: JR133547 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CONTRAT A DUREE MAXIMALE DE 12 MOIS CONTEXTE Au sein de l’équipe Qualité et Fiabilité, vous contribuez à l’amélioration de la performance qualité en pilotant des projets d’amélioration continue et en développant des outils de pilotage basés sur la donnée. Le poste se situe à l’interface entre Qualité, amélioration continue et Data, avec un objectif : transformer les données disponibles en informations utiles pour comprendre, décider et agir. MISSIONS PRINCIPALES 1. Piloter des projets d’amélioration continue Qualité Identifier et analyser les problématiques et opportunités d’amélioration. Structurer et piloter des plans d’actions. Utiliser des méthodes de résolution de problèmes adaptées : PDCA, DMAIC, 5 Pourquoi, … Mesurer l’efficacité des actions mises en place. 2. Développer le pilotage par la donnée Identifier les données pertinentes pour le pilotage de la performance Qualité. Collecter, structurer et fiabiliser les données. Construire des KPI pertinents et compréhensibles. Automatiser autant que possible la préparation et la mise à disposition des indicateurs. Transformer les données en éléments d’aide à la décision. 3. Accompagner les équipes Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs. Proposer des solutions simples et adaptées au terrain. Présenter les analyses et résultats de manière claire et synthétique. Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’appropriation des nouveaux outils. QUELLES SONT LES CLES DE VOTRE REUSSITE AU SEIN DE NOTRE MAISON ? Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur, vous avez développé de l'expérience et des connaissances dans les domaines de la Qualité mais également la gestion de projets. jobs.title: Group International Mobility Manager

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile della Mobilità Internazionale del Gruppo
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la mobilité internationale du groupe

jobs.description: Reference code: JR133558 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is seeking a highly skilled Group International Mobility Manager to support the execution of our international mobility practice. In this role, you will ensure the smooth and compliant relocation of employees across international borders, enhancing operational excellence and the overall experience for our mobile population and Group entities. You will manage all aspects of the international assignment lifecycle, adhering to company policies, legal requirements, and best practices. Reporting to the Head of Global Mobility, you will support the translation of strategic framework designs into seamless, day-to-day processes, reinforcing governance and consistency, and expertly managing international assignments with a strong focus on policy application and compliance. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will position International Mobility as a strong operational and business-enabling capability for HR, combining delivery excellence, stakeholder partnership, mobility governance, and continuous improvement. In Particular, You will: Own the end-to-end delivery of international mobility assignments (e.g., long-term assignments, short-term assignments), ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely execution. Provide expert guidance and support on international mobility policies, benefits, and processes to assignees, their families, and business stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for our business stakeholders throughout the entire assignment lifecycle. Interpret Group International Mobility policies and guidelines, ensuring consistent and fair application across the organization. Ensure strict compliance with internal policies and external regulations related to international mobility. Coordinate and manage relationships with external vendors, including tax advisors. Monitor vendor performance and ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) are met, guaranteeing efficient and effective service delivery. Stay abreast of global immigration, tax, and social security regulations relevant to international assignments. Collaborate closely with legal and tax departments to ensure compliance and proactively mitigate risks. Partner with HR Business Partners and Compensation & Benefits teams to prepare comprehensive assignment cost projections and compensation packages. Provide comprehensive support to assignees and their families, addressing queries and concerns related to relocation, cultural adjustment, and integration, fostering a positive employee experience. Maintain accurate records and data within international mobility management systems. Prepare insightful reports and analyses on assignment costs, trends, and compliance metrics to support decision-making. Act as a subject matter expert, providing expert advice, training, and support to HR Teams and business on international mobility topics. Contribute to and support the continuous improvement, optimization, simplification, and automation of international mobility processes, tools, and guidelines to enhance scalability, efficiency and sustainable delivery across teams. Leverage project management methodologies and Agile principles to drive the delivery of mobility enhancements, ensuring alignment between business priorities, capacity, and execution. Promote effective communication and understanding of international mobility policies and processes. Actively participate in and contribute to international mobility projects and strategic initiatives. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, International Relations, Law, or a related field (Master's a plus). 5+ years of solid experience in international mobility management, with a strong understanding of various assignment types, policies, and compliance (tax, social security, immigration) in a complex international environment. A solid grasp of international mobility trends, best practices, and regulatory frameworks. In-depth expertise in international tax implications for assignees and the company, including tax equalization, hypothetical tax, gross-up, social security agreements, and compliance requirements in various jurisdictions. Understanding employment law, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and other legal aspects relevant to international assignments Excellent client focus, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and cultures. Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving capabilities, meticulous attention to detail, and proven adaptability in a dynamic environment. Demonstrated capability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with international assignments. Proven project management skills, able to lead or significantly contribute to international mobility projects. Proficiency in HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, Workday) and international mobility management software, as well as Microsoft Office Suite. Fluent in English; French is an asset. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value collegiality, courage, curiosity, empathy, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group HR Operations Process Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group Talent Communities Management Director Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133558 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Richemont sta cercando un Group International Mobility Manager altamente qualificato per sostenere l'esecuzione della nostra pratica di mobilità internazionale. In questo ruolo, vi assicurerete il trasferimento regolare e conforme dei dipendenti attraverso i confini internazionali, migliorando l'eccellenza operativa e l'esperienza complessiva per la nostra popolazione mobile e entità di Gruppo. Potrai gestire tutti gli aspetti del ciclo di vita di assegnazione internazionale, aderendo alle politiche aziendali, requisiti legali e best practice. Segnalando al Capo della Mobilità Globale, sosterrai la traduzione dei progetti strategici in processi senza soluzione di continuità, di giorno in giorno, rafforzando la governance e la coerenza e gestendo sapientemente le assegnazioni internazionali con una forte attenzione all'applicazione e alla conformità delle politiche. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In questo ruolo, si posiziona la mobilità internazionale come una forte capacità operativa e business-abilitativa per le risorse umane, combinando l'eccellenza della consegna, il partenariato stakeholder, la governance della mobilità e il miglioramento continuo. In particolare, Lei sarà: Possedere la consegna end-to-end di incarichi di mobilità internazionale (ad esempio, assegnazioni a lungo termine, assegnazioni a breve termine), assicurando l'esecuzione accurata, coerente e tempestiva. Fornisci una guida esperta e un supporto alle politiche, ai benefici e ai processi di mobilità internazionale per assegnare, le loro famiglie e gli stakeholder aziendali. Servire come punto di contatto principale per i nostri stakeholder aziendali durante l'intero ciclo di vita di assegnazione. Interpret Group International Mobility policy e linee guida, garantendo un'applicazione coerente e corretta in tutta l'organizzazione. Assicurare un rigoroso rispetto delle politiche interne e delle normative esterne relative alla mobilità internazionale. Coordinare e gestire le relazioni con i fornitori esterni, compresi i consulenti fiscali. Monitorare le prestazioni del fornitore e garantire il livello di servizio Accordi (SLA) sono soddisfatti, garantendo la consegna efficiente ed efficace del servizio. Rimani al passo con le normative internazionali in materia di immigrazione, tasse e sicurezza sociale. Collaborare a stretto contatto con i servizi legali e fiscali per garantire la conformità e mitigare proattivamente i rischi. Collabora con i team HR Business Partners e Compensation & Benefits per preparare proiezioni complete di costi di assegnazione e pacchetti di compensazione. Fornire un supporto completo agli assegnatori e alle loro famiglie, rivolgendo domande e preoccupazioni relative al trasferimento, alla regolazione culturale e all'integrazione, favorendo un'esperienza positiva dei dipendenti. Mantenere registri e dati accurati all'interno di sistemi di gestione della mobilità internazionale. Prepara report e analisi approfondite sui costi di assegnazione, le tendenze e le metriche di conformità per supportare il processo decisionale. Agire come esperto di materia tematica, fornire consigli esperti, formazione, e il supporto ai team di risorse umane e business su temi di mobilità internazionale. Contribuisci e supporta il miglioramento continuo, l'ottimizzazione, la semplificazione e l'automazione dei processi di mobilità internazionale, strumenti e linee guida per migliorare scalabilità, efficienza e consegna sostenibile in team. Leverage metodologie di gestione del progetto e principi Agile per guidare la consegna dei miglioramenti della mobilità, garantendo l'allineamento tra priorità aziendali, capacità ed esecuzione. Promuovere una comunicazione efficace e la comprensione delle politiche e dei processi di mobilità internazionale. Partecipare attivamente e contribuire a progetti di mobilità internazionale e iniziative strategiche. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Corso di laurea in HR, Business, Relazioni Internazionali, Diritto o un campo correlato (Master's a plus). 5+ anni di solida esperienza nella gestione della mobilità internazionale, con una forte comprensione di vari tipi di assegnazione, politiche e conformità (tax, sicurezza sociale, immigrazione) in un ambiente internazionale complesso. Una solida conoscenza delle tendenze della mobilità internazionale, delle migliori pratiche e dei quadri normativi. Competenze approfondite nelle implicazioni fiscali internazionali per gli assegnatori e la società, tra cui l'equalizzazione fiscale, l'imposta ipotetica, il lordo, gli accordi di previdenza sociale e i requisiti di conformità in varie giurisdizioni. Comprendere il diritto del lavoro, le normative sulla privacy dei dati (ad esempio, GDPR), e altri aspetti legali rilevanti per le assegnazioni internazionali Ottimi focus del cliente, la comunicazione e le competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente tra team e culture diverse. Mindset analitico con forti capacità di problem solving, meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli e comprovata adattabilità in un ambiente dinamico. Capacità dimostrata di identificare, valutare e mitigare i rischi associati a incarichi internazionali. Prove capacità di gestione del progetto, in grado di condurre o contribuire in modo significativo ai progetti di mobilità internazionale. La competenza nei sistemi HRIS (ad esempio, SAP, Workday) e nel software di gestione della mobilità internazionale, così come Microsoft Office Suite. Fluente in inglese; il francese è un bene. Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Apprezziamo la collegialità, il coraggio, la curiosità, l'empatia, l'umiltà e l'integrità. - No. Ci preoccupiamo del mondo in cui viviamo. TUO GIORNO CON NOI Se la vostra domanda è selezionata, arriveremo a breve per una chiamata introduttiva. Nell'ambito del processo di intervista, garantiamo sempre una completa comprensione e trasparenza, vale a dire, avrete la possibilità di incontrare persone che saranno cruciali per il vostro futuro successo nel ruolo #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Simili Jobs Group HR Operations Process Manager Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont Group Talent Communities Management Director Save Bellevue, Svizzera Richemont

• Anforderungen und Best Practices. B. langfristige Aufträge, kurzfristige Aufträge), um eine genaue, konsistente und zeitnahe Ausführung zu gewährleisten. Bereitstellung von fachkundiger Beratung und Unterstützung zu internationalen Mobilitätsrichtlinien, Vorteilen und Prozessen für Mitarbeiter, ihre Familien und geschäftliche Stakeholder. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR133558 Richemont possède quelques-uns des principaux produits de luxe du monde, avec des atouts particuliers en bijoux, montres fines et accessoires haut de gamme. Chaque Maison représente une fière tradition de style, de qualité et d'artisanat et Richemont cherche à préserver le patrimoine et l'identité de chacune de ses Maisons. Dans le même temps, nous sommes engagés dans l'innovation et la conception de nouveaux produits qui sont conformes à nos valeurs Maisons, à travers un processus de créativité continue. Richemont cherche un Group International Mobility Manager hautement qualifié pour soutenir l'exécution de notre pratique de mobilité internationale. Dans ce rôle, vous assurerez une réinstallation harmonieuse et conforme des employés au-delà des frontières internationales, en renforçant l'excellence opérationnelle et l'expérience globale pour notre population mobile et les entités du Groupe. Vous gérerez tous les aspects du cycle de vie des missions internationales, en respectant les politiques de l'entreprise, les exigences légales et les meilleures pratiques. Relevant du chef de la mobilité mondiale, vous soutiendrez la traduction des conceptions de cadres stratégiques en processus continus, en renforçant la gouvernance et la cohérence, et en gérant expertement les missions internationales en mettant fortement l'accent sur l'application et la conformité des politiques. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? Dans ce rôle, vous positionnerez la mobilité internationale comme une solide capacité opérationnelle et d'affaires pour les RH, combinant l'excellence de la prestation, le partenariat avec les intervenants, la gouvernance de la mobilité et l'amélioration continue. En particulier, vous serez propriétaire de l'exécution de bout en bout des missions de mobilité internationale (p. ex., les missions à long terme, les missions à court terme), assurant une exécution précise, cohérente et opportune. Fournir des conseils et un soutien spécialisés sur les politiques, les avantages et les processus de mobilité internationale aux cessionnaires, à leur famille et aux intervenants commerciaux. Servir de point de contact principal pour nos intervenants commerciaux tout au long du cycle de vie de l'affectation. Interpréter les politiques et les lignes directrices du Groupe sur la mobilité internationale, en assurant une application uniforme et équitable dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Veiller au strict respect des politiques internes et des règlements externes relatifs à la mobilité internationale. Coordonner et gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs externes, y compris les conseillers fiscaux. Surveiller le rendement des fournisseurs et veiller à ce que les ententes sur les niveaux de service (ALS) soient respectées, en garantissant une prestation de services efficace et efficiente. Restez au courant des réglementations mondiales en matière d'immigration, de fiscalité et de sécurité sociale qui concernent les missions internationales. Collaborer étroitement avec les services juridiques et fiscaux pour assurer la conformité et atténuer les risques de façon proactive. Établir des partenariats avec les partenaires des RH et les équipes de la rémunération et des avantages sociaux afin de préparer des projections détaillées des coûts d'affectation et des ensembles de rémunération. Fournir un soutien complet aux cessionnaires et à leur famille, en répondant aux questions et aux préoccupations relatives à la réinstallation, à l'adaptation culturelle et à l'intégration, en favorisant une expérience positive des employés. Tenir des registres et des données exacts au sein des systèmes internationaux de gestion de la mobilité. Préparer des rapports et des analyses éclairés sur les coûts d'affectation, les tendances et les mesures de conformité pour appuyer la prise de décisions. Agir en tant qu'expert en la matière, fournir des conseils, de la formation et un soutien aux équipes de RH et aux entreprises sur des sujets liés à la mobilité internationale. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue, à l'optimisation, à la simplification et à l'automatisation des processus, des outils et des lignes directrices en matière de mobilité internationale afin d'améliorer l'évolutivité, l'efficacité et la prestation durable entre les équipes. Mettre à profit les méthodes de gestion de projet et les principes Agiles pour favoriser l'amélioration de la mobilité, en assurant l'alignement entre les priorités opérationnelles, les capacités et l'exécution. Promouvoir une communication et une compréhension efficaces des politiques et des processus de mobilité internationale. Participer activement et contribuer aux projets de mobilité internationale et aux initiatives stratégiques. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre? Baccalauréat en RH, affaires, relations internationales, droit, ou un domaine connexe (Master's a plus). 5 ans et plus d'expérience solide dans la gestion de la mobilité internationale, avec une bonne compréhension des différents types d'affectation, politiques et conformité (impôt, sécurité sociale, immigration) dans un environnement international complexe. Une bonne compréhension des tendances de la mobilité internationale, des meilleures pratiques et des cadres réglementaires. Expertise approfondie en matière d'incidences fiscales internationales pour les cessionnaires et l'entreprise, y compris la péréquation fiscale, l'impôt hypothétique, la majoration, les accords de sécurité sociale et les exigences de conformité dans divers pays. Comprendre le droit de l'emploi, les règlements sur la protection des données (p. ex. RGPD) et d'autres aspects juridiques pertinents pour les affectations internationales. Un état d'esprit analytique avec de fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes, une attention méticuleuse aux détails et une adaptabilité éprouvée dans un environnement dynamique. Capacité démontrée d'identifier, d'évaluer et d'atténuer les risques associés aux missions internationales. Compétences éprouvées en gestion de projets, capables de diriger ou de contribuer de façon significative à des projets de mobilité internationale. Compétence dans les systèmes HRIS (par exemple SAP, Workday) et les logiciels de gestion de la mobilité internationale, ainsi que Microsoft Office Suite. Le français est un atout. Qu'est-ce qui fait que notre groupe est différent? Notre véritable pouvoir ne réside pas dans nos similarités, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique de favoriser un potentiel inexploité. Nous apprécions la collégialité, le courage, la curiosité, l'empathie, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Oui. Nous nous soucions du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE JOURNÉE AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, nous contacterons prochainement pour un appel d'introduction. Dans le cadre du processus d'entrevue, nous assurons toujours une compréhension et une transparence complètes, à savoir que vous aurez la chance de rencontrer des personnes qui seront cruciales pour votre réussite future dans le rôle #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Emplois Similaires Groupe HR Operations Process Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Groupe Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Groupe Talent Communities Management Director Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont
