jobs.title: Retail Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133589 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. We would like to talk to you about the opportunity to join, for one year, our International Retail Solutions department, as Retail Operations Coordinator. The Retail Operations Coordinator, based in Couvet, supports the STAGE Manager in overseeing daily operations at STAGE, Cartier’s experiential space and mock-up boutique dedicated to retail experimentation and training. In this multi-task role, the coordinator helps ensure smooth running of activities such as testing, training, role play, filming, and product demonstrations, while securing all necessary resources and requirements. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? RETAIL OPERATIONS & AREA MAINTENANCE Run monthly inventories, deliver reports, and process SAP receipts/returns. Manage quarterly stock updates (returns and novelty orders). Oversee STAGE equipment supply and coordinate shipping (packaging, customs). Maintain hardware/software for IT testing and manage broadcasting systems. Align VM with global campaigns and coordinate general maintenance. Partner with the Retail Solutions Team to test and integrate prototypes. Visit boutiques regularly to identify and suggest operational improvements. Exchange best practices and network with global Retail Ops peers. VISITS PREPARATION & MANAGEMENT Prepare the STAGE area for visitors alongside the Hospitality & Event coordinator. Operate the STAGE broadcasting system. Lead engaging group tours (FR/EN) focusing on retail innovation and boutique operations. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You have 5 years of experience in Retail Operations or Retail Logistics. Youa are proficient in Office 365 and digital tools; knowledge of SAP (stock management) is a strong plus. You are highly organized, proactive, autonomous, agile, and a strong communicator. You are flexible and at ease in a fast-changing environment. You are fluent in English and French On-site presence required (maximum 20% remote work, depending on operational needs). WHAT DO WE OFFER? We create a positive environment and highlight your personal and team performances. We’re fully transparent and share with you: Maison strategies, key information, needs of others Corporate Departments. We constantly educate you with: Cartier’s savoir-faire, competitive landscape, industry news, client experience best practices. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will give you an introductory call to further discuss the opportunity, and next steps. If things go well on both ends, you will have a chance to meet the the hiring manager and the HR Partner. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133589 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. Vorremmo parlare con voi dell'opportunità di unire, per un anno, il nostro dipartimento International Retail Solutions, come Coordinatore delle operazioni al dettaglio. Il Coordinatore delle Operazioni al dettaglio, con sede a Couvet, supporta lo STAGE Manager nella supervisione delle operazioni giornaliere presso STAGE, lo spazio esperienziale di Cartier e la boutique dedicata alla sperimentazione e alla formazione al dettaglio. In questo ruolo multi-task, il coordinatore aiuta a garantire un funzionamento regolare di attività come test, formazione, gioco di ruolo, film e dimostrazioni di prodotto, garantendo al tempo stesso tutte le risorse e i requisiti necessari. Come fai a fare un'infezione? OPERALI DI RETAIL & AREA MAINTENANCE Eseguire gli inventari mensili, fornire report e elaborare le ricevute/ritorni SAP. Gestisci aggiornamenti trimestrali (ritorni e ordini di novità). Superare la fornitura di attrezzature STAGE e coordinare la spedizione (imballaggio, dogana). Mantenere hardware/software per testare e gestire i sistemi di trasmissione. Allineare VM con campagne globali e coordinare la manutenzione generale. Partner del Retail Solutions Team per testare e integrare i prototipi. Visitare le boutique regolarmente per identificare e suggerire miglioramenti operativi. Scambi le migliori pratiche e la rete con i coetanei di Retail Ops globali. PREPARAZIONE E GESTIONE Preparare l'area STAGE per i visitatori insieme al coordinatore Hospitality & Event. Operare il sistema di trasmissione STAGE. Lead coinvolgenti tour di gruppo (FR/EN) che si concentrano sull'innovazione al dettaglio e sulle operazioni di boutique. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Hai 5 anni di esperienza nelle operazioni al dettaglio o nella logistica al dettaglio. Youa è competente in Office 365 e strumenti digitali; la conoscenza di SAP (stock management) è un vantaggio forte. Sei altamente organizzato, proattivo, autonomo, agile e un forte comunicatore. Sei flessibile e a tuo agio in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Siete fluenti in inglese e francese Presenza in loco necessaria (massimo 20% di lavoro remoto, a seconda delle esigenze operative). Che cosa facciamo? Creiamo un ambiente positivo ed evidenziamo le prestazioni personali e di squadra. Siamo completamente trasparenti e condividiamo con voi: strategie di Maison, informazioni chiave, esigenze di altri dipartimenti aziendali. Vi istruiamo costantemente con: il savoir-faire di Cartier, il paesaggio competitivo, le notizie del settore, le migliori pratiche di esperienza del cliente. TUA GIORNATA CON NOI Se la vostra applicazione è selezionata, vi daremo una chiamata introduttiva per discutere ulteriormente l'opportunità, e i prossimi passi. Se le cose vanno bene su entrambe le estremità, avrete la possibilità di incontrare il gestore di assunzione e il partner HR. descriptionByLocale.de: Bezugscode: JR133589 Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren haben wir einen mutigen Pioniergeist, der unsere Teams in allen Métiers von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Firmenbüros inspiriert. Unsere mehr als 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationalitäten sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und Engagement für Exzellenz vereint und streben danach, das Erbe unseres Hauses kontinuierlich zu bereichern, indem wir die Grenzen von Kreativität und Innovation überschreiten. Wir möchten mit Ihnen über die Möglichkeit sprechen, für ein Jahr unserer Abteilung für internationale Einzelhandelslösungen als Retail Operations Coordinator beizutreten. Der Retail Operations Coordinator mit Sitz in Couvet unterstützt den STAGE Manager bei der Überwachung des täglichen Betriebs bei STAGE, Cartiers Erlebnisraum und Mock-up-Boutique, die sich dem Experimentieren und Training im Einzelhandel widmet. In dieser Multi-Task-Rolle trägt der Koordinator dazu bei, einen reibungslosen Ablauf von Aktivitäten wie Testen, Training, Rollenspiel, Filmen und Produktdemonstrationen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig alle notwendigen Ressourcen und Anforderungen zu sichern. WIE WERDEN SIE EINEN AUSWIRKEN SIND? RETAIL- OPERATIONEN UND GEBIET INSTANDHALTUNG Führen Sie monatliche Inventare aus, liefern Sie Berichte und verarbeiten Sie SAP-Eingänge/Rückgaben. Verwalten Sie vierteljährliche Bestandsaktualisierungen (Returns und Neuheiten). Beaufsichtigen Sie die Lieferung von STAGE-Ausrüstung und koordinieren Sie den Versand (Verpackung, Zoll). Pflegen Sie Hardware/Software für IT-Tests und die Verwaltung von Rundfunksystemen. VM an globalen Kampagnen ausrichten und allgemeine Wartung koordinieren. Partnerschaft mit dem Retail Solutions Team, um Prototypen zu testen und zu integrieren. Besuchen Sie regelmäßig Boutiquen, um operative Verbesserungen zu identifizieren und vorzuschlagen. Austausch von Best Practices und Netzwerk mit globalen Retail Ops Peers. VORBEREITUNG UND VERWALTUNG VON BESUCHEN Bereiten Sie den STAGE-Bereich für Besucher neben dem Hospitality & Event-Koordinator vor. Betreiben Sie das STAGE Broadcasting System. Führen Sie engagierte Gruppenreisen (FR/EN) mit Schwerpunkt auf Innovationen im Einzelhandel und Boutique-Aktivitäten durch. WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS? Sie haben 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Retail Operations oder Retail Logistics. Youa beherrscht Office 365 und digitale Tools; Kenntnisse in SAP (Aktienmanagement) sind ein starkes Plus. Sie sind hoch organisiert, proaktiv, autonom, agil und ein starker Kommunikator. Sie sind flexibel und wohl in einer sich schnell verändernden Umgebung. Sie sprechen fließend Englisch und Französisch Vor-Ort-Präsenz (maximal 20% Remote-Arbeit, abhängig von den betrieblichen Bedürfnissen). Was bieten wir an? Wir schaffen ein positives Umfeld und heben Ihre persönlichen und Teamleistungen hervor. Wir sind vollständig transparent und teilen mit Ihnen: Maison Strategien, wichtige Informationen, Bedürfnisse anderer Unternehmensabteilungen. Wir schulen Sie ständig mit: Cartiers Know-how, Wettbewerbslandschaft, Branchennachrichten, Best Practices für Kunden. IHR JOURNEY MIT UNS Wenn Ihre Bewerbung ausgewählt ist, geben wir Ihnen einen einleitenden Anruf, um die Gelegenheit und die nächsten Schritte weiter zu besprechen. Wenn es an beiden Enden gut läuft, haben Sie die Möglichkeit, den Einstellungsmanager und den HR-Partner zu treffen. descriptionByLocale.fr: Code de référence: JR133589 L'histoire de Cartier est fondée sur la curiosité et la passion. Depuis plus de 170 ans, nous avons adopté un esprit audacieux et pionnier qui continue d'inspirer nos équipes de tous les Métiers, de nos boutiques à nos ateliers et bureaux corporatifs. Nos 10 000 collègues de plus de 105 nationalités sont unis par un esprit indépendant partagé et un engagement en faveur de l'excellence, s'efforçant d'enrichir continuellement notre patrimoine de Maison en repoussant les frontières de la créativité et de l'innovation. Nous aimerions vous parler de l'occasion de nous joindre, pendant un an, à notre service des solutions de vente internationale, en tant que coordonnateur des opérations de vente au détail. Le coordonnateur des opérations de détail, basé à Couvet, soutient le gestionnaire de STAGE dans la supervision des opérations quotidiennes à STAGE, Cartier. Dans ce rôle multitâches, le coordonnateur contribue à assurer le bon déroulement d'activités telles que les tests, la formation, le jeu de rôles, le tournage et la démonstration de produits, tout en obtenant toutes les ressources et exigences nécessaires. Comment allez-vous avoir un impact ? OPÉRATIONS DE DÉTAIL ET ENTRETIEN DE LA ZONE Exécuter des inventaires mensuels, produire des rapports et traiter les reçus/retours SAP. Gérer les mises à jour trimestrielles des stocks (retours et commandes de nouveauté). Surveiller la fourniture de matériel STAGE et coordonner l'expédition (emballage, douanes). Maintenir le matériel/logiciel pour les tests informatiques et gérer les systèmes de radiodiffusion. Aligner VM avec les campagnes mondiales et coordonner l'entretien général. Partenaire avec l'équipe Solutions Retail pour tester et intégrer des prototypes. Visitez régulièrement les boutiques pour identifier et suggérer des améliorations opérationnelles. Échanger les meilleures pratiques et le réseau avec les pairs mondiaux des opérations de vente au détail. PRÉPARATION ET GESTION DES VISITES Préparer la zone STAGE pour les visiteurs aux côtés du coordonnateur Hospitality & Event. Fonctionnement du système de radiodiffusion STAGE. Diriger les visites de groupe (FR/EN) axées sur l'innovation au détail et les activités de boutique. Comment allez-vous nous convaincre? Vous avez 5 ans d'expérience en opérations de détail ou en logistique de détail. Youa est compétent en Office 365 et outils numériques; la connaissance de SAP (gestion des stocks) est un plus fort. Vous êtes très organisé, proactif, autonome, agile et un communicateur fort. Vous êtes flexible et à l'aise dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Vous parlez couramment anglais et français Présence sur place requise (maximum 20 % de travail à distance, selon les besoins opérationnels). Qu'est-ce qu'on fait ? Nous créons un environnement positif et mettons en valeur vos performances personnelles et d'équipe. Nous sommes pleinement transparents et nous partageons avec vous: Stratégies de Maison, informations clés, besoins des autres départements ministériels. Nous vous éduquons en permanence avec : CartierSavoir-faire, paysage concurrentiel, nouvelles de l'industrie, expérience client meilleures pratiques. VOTRE JOURNÉE AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, nous vous donnerons un appel d'introduction pour discuter plus avant de l'opportunité et des prochaines étapes. Si les choses vont bien aux deux bouts, vous aurez la chance de rencontrer le gestionnaire d'embauche et le partenaire RH. jobs.title: Chef de projet Qualité F/H
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133565 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. VOTRE RAISON D’ÊTRE AU SEIN DE LA MAISON En tant que support technique privilégié, vous accompagnerez l'ensemble de nos équipes qualité et veillerez à l'Assurance Qualité de nos développements produits. Venez contribuer activement à une culture d'amélioration continue et à l'atteinte de nos objectifs qualité les plus ambitieux. Vous serez un acteur clé dans la naissance de chaque nouveau calibre. VOTRE RÔLE À JOUER En rejoignant notre équipe, vous serez un pilier essentiel de notre démarche qualité, avec des responsabilités variées et stimulantes. Pilotage de Projets Qualité Stratégiques : Vous coordonnez des projets qualité transverses pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits et processus. Vous assurez la gestion complète du déploiement et du suivi de ces projets (respect des plannings, animation des comités de suivi bimensuels avec la direction, soutien et relance des équipes). Vous initiez et contribuez à la démarche d’amélioration continue axés sur les problématiques dimensionnelles et esthétiques. Vous contribuez activement aux projets d'innovation de la Maison. Support Opérationnel et Amélioration Continue : Vous assurez un support technique quotidien à l'ensemble du département Qualité. Vous êtes acteur dans la définition, le déploiement et l’exploitation des outils Qualité multi-services au sein de l’entreprise. Vous assurez le back-up du rôle de technicien qualité, incluant le pilotage des QRQC Vous initiez et suivez la résolution de problèmes liés aux rebuts, en garantissant la rigueur des démarches (arbres des causes, respect des étapes, etc.). Développement et Suivi des Indicateurs de Performance : Vous participez activement à la définition, la mise en place et la maintenance des KPI pour tous les départements Qualité. Vous contribuez à la création d'indicateurs Qualité pertinents en exploitant des données issues de SAP, PowerBI, SharePoint et Excel. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les différents métiers pour harmoniser les pratiques et définir de nouvelles règles communes. LES QUALITÉS POUR EXCELLER : La réussite dans ce rôle repose sur : Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation Technicienne ES, CFC ou d'un titre jugé équivalent dans le domaine de la micromécanique, de la mécanique générale ou de l'horlogerie. Une formation complémentaire en contrôle qualité, métrologie ou assurance qualité serait un réel atout. Une expérience significative en tant que Chef de projet qualité, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture horlogère, ou dans un environnement industriel exigent lier aux lignes de production, à la conduite de projet et à l'amélioration continue. Votre maîtrise des aspects techniques de la fabrication industrielle et votre excellente connaissance des instruments de mesure. Votre expertise sur les démarches d’amélioration continue et de résolution de problèmes (5 Pourquoi, 8D, PDCA, AMDEC...). Votre maitrise de SAP et des outils bureautiques (traitement de texte, tableur avancé avec graphes et tableaux croisés dynamiques, outils de présentation). Votre excellent sens de l'écoute et de la communication, vous maîtrisez l'art de piloter et d'animer des séances de travail de manière efficace. Votre esprit d'analyse et de synthèse sont reconnus. Vous faites preuve de méthodes et de pertinence. Votre capacité à anticiper, faire preuve de réactivité, d'adaptabilité et d'une capacité à vous remettre en question. Votre pédagogie, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et avez un sens aigu du service. Vacheron Constantin a célébré 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Prêt(e) à faire partie de notre histoire ? Nous serons ravis de découvrir votre candidature. jobs.title: Team Leader Pick & Pack
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133646 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXTE Richemont International Distribution recrute pour son centre de distribution de Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Pick & Pack. Vous aurez la responsabilité de garantir la bonne exécution et la conformité des opérations Pick & Pack selon les réglementations et directives ainsi que le management opérationnel de l’équipe. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? 
• Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Grâce à votre relationnel constructif et votre orientation résultats, vous savez créer les bonnes conditions pour emmener votre équipe d’opérateurs logistiques à atteindre les objectifs de qualité, coût, délai et sécurité. Vous les soutenez au quotidien dans la réalisation de leur activité par le coaching et l’animation de la performance. Par votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité d’analyse, vous veillez, avec vos collègues, à développer continuellement la performance de votre secteur. De plus, nous pouvons compter sur vous pour faire l’extra mile qui satisfera nos clients à 100%. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS REUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Au bénéfice d’une formation supérieure (HEG, Université ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en gestion d’équipe et de projet. Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances dans le domaine de la logistique et de la Supply Chain. Vous aimez travailler sur le terrain, au cœur des activités, dans un environnement dynamique et challengeant et êtes disposé à travailler en équipe d’après-midi (13h-22h). Rigoureux, organisé et autonome, vous avez une bonne résistance au stress et êtes capable de comprendre/anticiper les problèmes et de visionner un impact ou une solution. Excellent communicateur, vous assurez une communication efficiente avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes et vous vous démarquez par votre force de proposition et votre capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. La maîtrise de SAP ainsi que de POWER BI (ou autre outil d’analyse de datas) sont un atout. Vous avez une parfaite maîtrise du français (C2) ainsi qu’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de communiquer aisément (min. B2). QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’équipe RH vous contacterons pour un premier échange téléphonique. Ensuite, un entretien avec le manager direct sera planifié. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Team Leader Process Operations Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont GL Accountant Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Référent technique polissage Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Cartier Manufacture

jobs.description: Reference code: JR133614 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Missions Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 2 ans pour obtenir votre Attestation Fédéral de formation Professionelle d’Opérateur·trice en horlogerie. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de l’horlogerie. Au cours de cette formation, vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur une diversité de modèles de montres, tout en acquérant des savoir-faire essentiels en matière d'efficacité et de productivité. Responsabilités Maîtriser l'assemblage de mouvements mécaniques, automatiques et à quartz Réaliser l'habillage des montres : pose des cadrans et des aiguilles, emboîtage et fixation du bracelet Acquérir les bases techniques du polissage S'initier aux fondamentaux de la micromécanique Participer à divers stages pratiques au sein de nos ateliers et auprès d'entreprises partenaires. CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Connaissances suffisantes du français à l'oral comme à l'écrit permettant de réussir sa formation professionnelle Aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques Intérêt et curiosité et motivation pour les produits horlogers et les mécanismes de précision Dextérité manuelle, autonomie et rigueur Faculté de concentration, patience et raisonnement logique Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Si vous êtes motivé·e, nous serons ravis d'étudier votre dossier de candidature complet, qui sera examiné par nos équipes de recrutement et de formation. Si votre profil retient notre attention, vous serez convié·e à une journée découverte et/ou recrutement axée sur divers tests pratiques et théoriques. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier. jobs.title: Team Leader Process Operations
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133644 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. CONTEXTE Richemont International Distribution recrute pour son centre de distribution de Villars-sur-Glâne, un Team Leader Process Operations. Vous aurez la responsabilité de manager et coordonner l’équipe de Spécialiste Process Opérations, qui ont pour mission de faciliter l’identification des dérives de processus et résoudre les problèmes opérationnels. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ? 
• Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : Grâce à votre relationnel constructif et votre orientation résultats, vous savez créer les bonnes conditions pour emmener votre équipe de Spécialiste Proces à atteindre les objectifs de qualité, coût, délai et sécurité. Vous les soutenez au quotidien dans la réalisation de leur activité par le coaching et l’animation de la performance. Par votre esprit d’équipe et votre capacité d’analyse, vous veillez, avec vos collègues, à développer continuellement la performance de votre secteur. De plus, nous pouvons compter sur vous pour faire l’extra mile qui satisfera nos clients à 100%. COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS REUSSIR AVEC NOUS ? Au bénéfice d’une formation supérieure (HEG, Université ou équivalent), vous justifiez d’une expérience confirmée en gestion d’équipe, de projet et Management de la Qualité. Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances dans le domaine de la logistique et de la Supply Chain. Rigoureux, organisé et autonome, vous avez une bonne résistance au stress et êtes capable de comprendre/anticiper les problèmes et de visionner un impact ou une solution. Excellent communicateur, vous assurez une communication efficiente avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes et vous vous démarquez par votre force de proposition et votre capacité à fédérer. Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise avec les outils informatiques usuels. La maîtrise de SAP et d’outils d’analyses de datas sont un atout. Vous avez une parfaite maîtrise du français (C2) ainsi qu’un niveau d’anglais vous permettant de communiquer aisément (min. B2). QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ? Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités. - Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité. - Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité. - Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons. VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’équipe RH vous contacterons pour un premier échange téléphonique. Ensuite, un entretien avec le manager direct sera planifié. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Team Leader Pick & Pack Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont GL Accountant Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Richemont Ingénieur Amélioration continue Save Geneva, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description: Reference code: JR133762 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. Vacheron Constantin célèbre 270 ans en tant que plus ancienne manufacture horlogère au monde, en activité continue depuis 1755. Basée à Genève, Suisse, notre Maison opère un réseau mondial de près de 200 points de vente dans 36 pays. Chaque membre de notre communauté exceptionnelle – horlogers, artisans et professionnels – partage une même passion pour notre héritage et l’ambition de construire un avenir encore plus radieux. Au sein du département Manufacturing, la/le Responsable de Ligne Produit est en charge des process industriels (ébauche, terminaison, garnissage) intervenants dans la production d’une même famille de produit. Dans ce cadre, elle/ il assure un pilotage rigoureux et quotidien de son périmètre en termes de planification, management des ressources, pilotage des actions correctives, productivité dans le respect simultané des critères qualité, quantité, coûts, délais, sécurité. Elle/ il accompagne à la fois l’industrialisation de nouveaux développements produits et la production en vie série sur sa ligne et participe activement au processus d'amélioration continue avec l’appui des supports Qualité, Méthode et des Référents Techniques dédiés par process. La/ le Responsable de ligne produit anime une équipe pluridisciplinaire (de 20 à 35 personnes) représentant plusieurs métiers de l’environnement machines et manuel. jobs.title: Compliance intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133753 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Join our dynamic Group Legal team at Richemont and gain invaluable experience in a vibrant multinational environment. As a compliance intern, you will support the central compliance function by contributing to a broad range of compliance projects and initiatives. This includes exposure to areas such as regulatory risk management, regulatory watch and legal developments monitoring, competition law, anti-money laundering (AML), sanctions compliance, anti-corruption, and conflicts of interest. The role provides hands-on experience with compliance processes and activities, offering valuable insight into the operation of a global compliance program. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? The key responsibilities for this role will be:
• Assist in reviewing and enhancing AML, sanctions, and anti-corruption compliance procedures and controls.
• Conduct research on competition (antitrust) law topics and contribute to the preparation of guidelines, FAQs, and training materials.
• Contribute to the deployment of various compliance disclosure and approval tools.
• Contribute to the development and roll-out of compliance training programs and awareness campaigns.
• Assist in the preparation of compliance reports, dashboards, and presentations for management.
• Participate in in and contribute to departmental meetings and projects.
• Work collaboratively in a multicultural and multilingual environment. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Currently enrolled in a full-time law degree or Bar Exam preparation.
• Previous experience as an intern in an international company or law firm is preferable
• Demonstrate robust legal skills with excellent drafting and communication capabilities.
• Personality is key: positive energy, with a strong team spirit, capable of adapting to an international and fast-paced setting
• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in French and/or German is a strong plus
• An internship agreement with your school/university is mandatory.
• You can commit to a 6-months internship with a starting date on or before 1 December 2026 WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.
• We value collegiality, humility, and integrity.
• We foster empathy, curiosity, courage.
• We care for the world we live in YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Mergers & Acquisitions Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre somiglianze, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e capacità umane, così come nella nostra specifica capacità di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato.

jobs.description: Reference code: JR133757 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Group Talent Communities Management Director, reporting to the HQ Group Talent Director, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Richemont's talent landscape. Your mission will be to define, develop, and animate our internal talent communities across all Maisons, Regions, and Functions. You will foster the growth, engagement, and retention of our diverse talents, ensuring alignment with our commercial ambitions, particularly within our retail business globally. This involves driving the strategic vision for talent management and ensuring consistent development paths across the Group. Your key responsibilities will include: Strategic planning: Define and implement the long-term vision and strategic axes for Talent Communities Management, including specific strategies for creative, marketing/merchandising, and retail talent management. You will contribute to overall capability development through targeted community animation and specific learning paths, while integrating external insights on market trends and innovations. Talent Management 360: You will ensure a global 360-degree view of talent management within communities, ensuring optimal talent pools are secured in close collaboration with HRDs and Talent Acquisition. This includes defining clear and consistent career paths, ensuring consistency in job catalogues and titles working closely with Group Rewards. You will also lead continuous management of assessment and career development tools, including Talent management process in Workday. Talent Assessment & Community Engagement: You will collaborate closely with Learning & Development teams to support the continuous upskilling and employability of our talents and structure the implementation of consistent and progressive career paths. You will also drive the development of robust succession plans and centralize internal mobility strategies. You will also build & monitor specific talent pools across Maisons’ HQ and Regions, with strong succession plans for senior management roles across all Maisons supporting their career development plans. You will contribute to the design and manage the operational implementation of international development programs for international retail sales experts and high-potential talents in the Group. Stakeholder Collaboration: You will animate the HR Talent Management community across Maisons and Divisions, organizing regular meetings on common priorities and projects and involve HR and partner departments in sharing the strategic vision and operational components. You will align with Maison HRDs, Regional teams, L&D, and Commercial/Marketing Directors to ensure a cohesive approach to talent management, actively participating in global talent meetings. Project Management & Communication: You will lead and ensure the proper execution of strategic talent projects, defining and monitoring key performance indicators for talent communities, and managing annual assessments for retail boutique managers and sales communities. Furthermore, you will develop and implement impactful communication strategies for key talent initiatives, ensuring effective communication of our talent strategy across all levels and to top management. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are a passionate and experienced HR professional with: A proven experience within the luxury fashion and accessories industry, with a strong understanding of: creative/design and studio functions as well as marketing, communication organizations with Maisons and regions. A minimum of 15-20 years of international HR and/or people management experience, ideally within a large, complex international group. Significant expertise in Talent Management, Talent Assessment, Development, and HR Business Partnering, with exposure to talent community management. A proven track record in project management, familiar with the Retail, Marketing, and/or Merchandising environments, ideally within the luxury sector. Knowledge and Experience in F&A is a strong plus. Mastery of HR development processes such as mobility management, succession planning, and learning & development. Strong analytical and synthesis skills, highly organized, rigorous, and adept at data analysis. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a natural ability to build and nurture internal networks. An open, creative, positive, results-oriented, and flexible mindset, thriving in matrix organizations and complex, fast-paced, multicultural environments. Strong stakeholder management and digital savviness. Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in other languages, particularly Chinese or Japanese, French and Italian are a plus. Strong analytical and numeric skills. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont HR Business Partner, Cartier CDD 24 mois Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

Talent Management 360: garantirai una visione globale a 360 gradi della gestione dei talenti all'interno delle comunità, assicurando ai pool di talenti ottimali una stretta collaborazione con HRD e Talent Acquisition. Ciò include la definizione di percorsi di carriera chiari e coerenti, garantendo coerenza nei cataloghi di lavoro e titoli che lavorano vicino con Group Rewards. Potrai anche condurre una gestione continua di strumenti di valutazione e sviluppo della carriera, tra cui il processo di gestione Talent in Workday. Potrai anche guidare lo sviluppo di robusti piani di successione e centralizzare le strategie di mobilità interna. Contribuirai alla progettazione e alla gestione dell'implementazione operativa di programmi di sviluppo internazionale per esperti di vendita al dettaglio internazionali e talenti altamente potenziali nel Gruppo. Collaborazione Stickholder: animerai la comunità HR Talent Management in Maisons and Divisions, organizzerai riunioni regolari su priorità e progetti comuni e coinvolgerai reparti HR e partner nella condivisione della visione strategica e dei componenti operativi. Potrai allineare con Maison HRDs, Regional team, L&D e Commercial/Marketing Directors per garantire un approccio coerente alla gestione dei talenti, partecipando attivamente a incontri di talento globali. Project Management & Communication: guiderai e garantirai l'esecuzione immobiliare di progetti di talento strategici, definendo e monitorando i principali indicatori di performance per le comunità di talenti e gestendo le valutazioni annuali per i manager di boutique e le comunità di vendita al dettaglio. Inoltre, svilupperai e implementerai strategie di comunicazione efficaci per iniziative chiave di talento, garantendo una comunicazione efficace della nostra strategia di talento su tutti i livelli e sulla massima gestione. Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Sei un professionista HR appassionato ed esperto con: un'esperienza comprovata all'interno del settore della moda e degli accessori di lusso, con una forte comprensione di: funzioni creative/design e studio, oltre a marketing, organizzazioni di comunicazione con Maison e regioni. Un minimo di 15-20 anni di esperienza internazionale di gestione delle risorse umane e/o delle persone, idealmente all'interno di un grande gruppo internazionale complesso. Competenze significative in Talent Management, Talent Assessment, Development e HR Business Partnering, con mostra alla gestione della community di talenti. Una comprovata esperienza nella gestione del progetto, familiare all'ambiente Retail, Marketing e/o Merchandising, idealmente all'interno del settore del lusso. La conoscenza e l'esperienza in F&A è un vantaggio forte. Mastery dei processi di sviluppo delle risorse umane come la gestione della mobilità, la pianificazione della successione e lo sviluppo dell'apprendimento e dell'apprendimento. Forte capacità analitiche e di sintesi, altamente organizzate, rigorose e adept all'analisi dei dati. Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione, con una naturale capacità di costruire e nutrire reti interne. Una mentalità aperta, creativa, positiva, orientata ai risultati e flessibile, che prospera in organizzazioni di matrice e ambienti complessi, veloci e multiculturali. Forte gestione del supporto e savviness digitale. La fluidità in inglese è essenziale; la facoltà in altre lingue, soprattutto cinese o giapponese, francese e italiano sono un plus. Forte capacità analitiche e digitali. Che cosa fa del nostro gruppo? Il nostro vero potere non risiede nelle nostre similitudini, ma nella ricca diversità delle nostre arti, culture e abilità umane, così come nella nostra capacità speciale di promuovere il potenziale non sfruttato. Nell'ambito del processo di intervista, garantiamo sempre una completa comprensione e trasparenza, vale a dire, avrete la possibilità di incontrare persone che saranno cruciali per il vostro futuro successo nel ruolo. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture similar Jobs Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Group HR Reporting Manager Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont

Projektmanagement & Kommunikation: Sie leiten und gewährleisten die Durchführung von strategischen Talentprojekten, definieren und überwachen wichtige Leistungsindikatoren für Talentgemeinschaften und verwalten jährliche Bewertungen für Einzelhandelsboutiquenmanager und Vertriebsgemeinschaften. Darüber hinaus entwickeln und implementieren Sie wirkungsvolle Kommunikationsstrategien für wichtige Talentinitiativen und gewährleisten eine effektive Kommunikation unserer Talentstrategie auf allen Ebenen und zum Top-Management. WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS? Mindestens 15-20 Jahre internationale HR- und / oder People-Management-Erfahrung, idealerweise innerhalb einer großen, komplexen internationalen Gruppe. Bedeutende Expertise in Talent Management, Talent Assessment, Entwicklung und HR Business Partnering, mit Ausstellung zu Talent Community Management. Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im Projektmanagement, vertraut mit der Retail-, Marketing- und / oder Merchandising-Umgebung, idealerweise im Luxussektor. Wissen und Erfahrung in F & A ist ein starkes Plus. Beherrschung von HR-Entwicklungsprozessen wie Mobilitätsmanagement, Nachfolgeplanung und Learning & Development. Starke analytische und Synthesefähigkeiten, hoch organisiert, streng und geschickt in der Datenanalyse. Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten, mit einer natürlichen Fähigkeit, interne Netzwerke aufzubauen und zu pflegen. Eine offene, kreative, positive, ergebnisorientierte und flexible Denkweise, die in Matrixorganisationen und komplexen, schnelllebigen, multikulturellen Umgebungen gedeiht. Starkes Inhabermanagement und digitales Know-how. Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch sind unerlässlich; Fakultät in anderen Sprachen, vor allem Chinesisch oder Japanisch, Französisch und Italienisch sind ein Plus. Starke analytische und digitale Fähigkeiten. Was macht unsere Gruppe anders? descriptionByLocale.fr: Reference code: JR133757 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Group Talent Communities Management Director, reporting to the HQ Group Talent Director, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Richemont's talent landscape. Your mission will be to define, develop, and animate our internal talent communities across all Maisons, Regions, and Functions. You will foster the growth, engagement, and retention of our diverse talents, ensuring alignment with our commercial ambitions, particularly within our retail business globally. This involves driving the strategic vision for talent management and ensuring consistent development paths across the Group. Your key responsibilities will include: Strategic planning: Define and implement the long-term vision and strategic axes for Talent Communities Management, including specific strategies for creative, marketing/merchandising, and retail talent management. You will contribute to overall capability development through targeted community animation and specific learning paths, while integrating external insights on market trends and innovations. Talent Management 360: You will ensure a global 360-degree view of talent management within communities, ensuring optimal talent pools are secured in close collaboration with HRDs and Talent Acquisition. This includes defining clear and consistent career paths, ensuring consistency in job catalogues and titles working closely with Group Rewards. You will also lead continuous management of assessment and career development tools, including Talent management process in Workday. Talent Assessment & Community Engagement: You will collaborate closely with Learning & Development teams to support the continuous upskilling and employability of our talents and structure the implementation of consistent and progressive career paths. You will also drive the development of robust succession plans and centralize internal mobility strategies. You will also build & monitor specific talent pools across Maisons’ HQ and Regions, with strong succession plans for senior management roles across all Maisons supporting their career development plans. You will contribute to the design and manage the operational implementation of international development programs for international retail sales experts and high-potential talents in the Group. Stakeholder Collaboration: You will animate the HR Talent Management community across Maisons and Divisions, organizing regular meetings on common priorities and projects and involve HR and partner departments in sharing the strategic vision and operational components. You will align with Maison HRDs, Regional teams, L&D, and Commercial/Marketing Directors to ensure a cohesive approach to talent management, actively participating in global talent meetings. Project Management & Communication: You will lead and ensure the proper execution of strategic talent projects, defining and monitoring key performance indicators for talent communities, and managing annual assessments for retail boutique managers and sales communities. Furthermore, you will develop and implement impactful communication strategies for key talent initiatives, ensuring effective communication of our talent strategy across all levels and to top management. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? You are a passionate and experienced HR professional with: A proven experience within the luxury fashion and accessories industry, with a strong understanding of: creative/design and studio functions as well as marketing, communication organizations with Maisons and regions. A minimum of 15-20 years of international HR and/or people management experience, ideally within a large, complex international group. Significant expertise in Talent Management, Talent Assessment, Development, and HR Business Partnering, with exposure to talent community management. A proven track record in project management, familiar with the Retail, Marketing, and/or Merchandising environments, ideally within the luxury sector. Knowledge and Experience in F&A is a strong plus. Mastery of HR development processes such as mobility management, succession planning, and learning & development. Strong analytical and synthesis skills, highly organized, rigorous, and adept at data analysis. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a natural ability to build and nurture internal networks. An open, creative, positive, results-oriented, and flexible mindset, thriving in matrix organizations and complex, fast-paced, multicultural environments. Strong stakeholder management and digital savviness. Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in other languages, particularly Chinese or Japanese, French and Italian are a plus. Strong analytical and numeric skills. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Group Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Talent Acquisition Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont HR Business Partner, Cartier CDD 24 mois Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133772 Since Watchfinder & Co. was first founded in 2002, it has grown to become the premier resource from which to buy and sell premium pre-owned watches. With thousands of watches available from more than 50 brands, including Rolex, Omega, IWC and more, plus boutiques across the UK and a manufacturer certified service centre, Watchfinder has established itself as the top pre-owned watch specialist. YOUR MISSION: The Sales & Purchasing Advisor is responsible for delivering stellar client experience and for achieving his/her personal sales targets as well as those of the boutique. He/She needs to act as an ambassador of Watchfinder at all times with client satisfaction being his/her utmost goals. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of a permanent position thereafter starting on October 1st, 2026 approx. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?
• Hosting clients and other stakeholders with the ability to provide personalised customer experience.
• Find ever new and creative means to exceed client’s expectations.
• Introduce clients to the different services that we offer, including the part-exchange service, maintaining a high level of experience to the clients.
• Developing personal clientele through effective use of the selling skills, proactive client outreach (CRM).
• Know WF’s history, services/products and partnerships as well as the benefits of purchasing a timepiece through Watchfinder.
• Act as a brand ambassador inside and outside the boutique.
• Maintain the boutique according to the global operating standards.
• Be part of a boutique team and support the overall organisation of the boutique with a strong team approach.
• Lead the appraisal process of timepieces that involve a part-exchange. Ensuring that all the necessary processes are followed accurately for the end user to make an assumption. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Applicants with a background in sales or hospitality preferred.
• Strong team player mindset.
• Excellent communicator with ability to develop strong networks.
• Curious and resourceful. Able to work independently on the sales process.
• Result-orientated and driven.
• Accountable and reliable.
• Able to handle a large diversity of tasks in a timely manner, very organised and disci-plined.
• Perfect understanding of client satisfaction and luxury experience and strong sense for etiquette and human behaviour.
• Able to approach individually to respective client.
• Open & Outgoing personality.
• Demonstrate eagerness and enthusiasm to learn and grow.
• Creative, curious and versatile with good interpersonal competences and empathetic.
• Has perfect manners and can maintain a conversation elegantly. Still wondering why, you should apply ? You will join a friendly and dynamic team with whom you will be able to share your knowledge and expertise Entrepreneurship, trust, integrity and agile learning are part of our great team spirit WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US Send your application online. If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication. jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description: Reference code: JR133785 Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen. At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches. FINANCIAL CONTROLLER PLAN-LES-OUATES CDI FOR THOSE WHO WELCOME CONNECTION Join a highly connected community where individual expertise and shared experience combine across disciplines to spark fresh ideas and keep us moving forwards. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE As a pivotal member of the Vacheron Constantin Finance Central Team, you will be instrumental in executing our ambitious Finance Roadmap along our Finance Strategy that is built upon four core pillars: Value Creation, Business Partnering, Continuous Improvement, and People Development. This highly visible role blends financial process transformation with hands-on analysis, performance management, and reporting. You'll architect and execute optimized financial operations, driving robust insights, operational excellence, and value creation in collaboration with HR, Purchasing, Central Accounting, Compliance, and Group FP&A. PLAYING YOUR PART Your expertise will be instrumental in several areas: FP&A PROCESS EXCELLENCE Drive continuous improvement and foster best practices in financial planning and analysis processes to enhance collective efficiency and accuracy (e.g., Performance reporting, Purchase Order management) Develop, implement, and evolve robust internal controls and financial procedures, ensuring compliance and mitigating risks, and adapting to technological advancements Align financials objectives with business strategy, developing scalable financial management approaches across departments and regions Support Headquarter business partners on Group reporting rules and systems CONTROLLING & REPORTING Lead and oversee the review and validation of monthly financial closings, adhering strictly to IFRS standards and Group policies and adopting a hands-on approach, as well as a close working relationship with Central Accounting Prepare insightful personnel costs reports with variance analysis and develop compelling presentations for executive decision-making (e.g., KPIs, trends, strategic recommendations) Lead regular business review meetings, discussing financial performance, forecasts, and strategic initiatives Identify optimization opportunities and foster strong partnerships with Purchasing teams for effective cost management TRANSVERSAL PROJECTS Actively contribute to and lead strategic projects focused on driving efficiencies and building a robust financial infrastructure for the Maison's long-term growth WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Master’s degree in Finance, Controlling, or Accounting +5 years of progressive experience in Finance or Corporate Controlling roles, including significant interaction with accounting shared service centers Exceptional analytical skills, capable of challenging ideas and proposing adapted solutions In-depth knowledge of IFRS standards, accounting rules, and internal control frameworks, with a keen interest in technological optimization (e.g., SAP, GCP & Looker, and AI for financial insights) Excellent communication skills (French and English) and interpersonal abilities, able to translate complex data into actionable strategic recommendations Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement and collaborate effectively within multi-functional teams and in a dynamic, international environment Service-oriented, proactive, self-starter with a courageous and humble attitude Vacheron Constantin celebrated 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If this fires your imagination, we welcome your application. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR133785 Fondato nel 1755, Vacheron Constantin è il mondo Al pinnacolo dell'Alta Orologeria e dell'eleganza sobria, la Maison crea segnatempo con firme tecniche ed estetiche uniche e un livello estremamente elevato di finiture. CONTROLLER FINANZIARIO PLAN-LES-OUATS CDI PER GLI OBIETTIVI CONNECATI Unisciti a una comunità altamente collegata in cui le competenze individuali e l'esperienza condivisa si combinano tra le discipline per parcheggiare idee fresche e tenerci in movimento. Gioca la tua parte nella guida del nostro successo collettivo. Il tuo! Come membro cardine del team centrale di finanza di Vacheron Constantin, sarete strumentali nello svolgimento della nostra ambiziosa roadmap di finanza lungo la nostra strategia di finanza che è costruita su quattro principali pillole: creazione di valore, business partner, miglioramento continuo e sviluppo della gente. Questo ruolo altamente visibile fonde la trasformazione dei processi finanziari con l'analisi pratica, la gestione delle prestazioni e il reporting. Potrai progettare ed eseguire operazioni finanziarie ottimizzate, guidando intuizioni robuste, eccellenza operativa e creazione di valore in collaborazione con HR, Acquisti, Contabilità Centrale, Compliance e Gruppo FP&A. La tua parte La vostra esperienza sarà strumentale in diversi settori: FP&A PROCESS EXCELLENCE Promuovere il miglioramento continuo e promuovere le migliori pratiche nei processi di pianificazione e analisi finanziaria per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza collettiva (ad esempio, reportistica sulle prestazioni, gestione degli ordini di acquisto) Sviluppo, implementazione e sviluppo di robusti controlli interni e procedure finanziarie, garanzia di conformità e mitigazione dei rischi, e adattamento ai progressi tecnologici Allineare gli obiettivi finanziari con la strategia aziendale, lo sviluppo di approcci di gestione finanziaria scalabile in tutti i dipartimenti e nelle regioni Supporti partner commerciali della sede centrale sulle regole di reporting del gruppo e sistemi CONTROLLING & REPORTING Lead e invertire la revisione e la convalida delle chiusure finanziarie mensili, seguendo rigorosamente gli standard e le politiche e le politiche e le politiche di Gruppo di business policy e le direttive del Gruppo, nonché le raccomandazioni relative ai costi di gestione dei conti. FINANCIAL CONTROLLER PLAN-LES-OUATS CDI FOR THOSE WHO WELCOME CONNECTION Join a highly connected community where individual expertise and shared experience combines across disciplines to park fresh ideas and keep us moving forwards. Play your part in driving our collective success. YOUR ROLE As a pivotal member of the Vacheron Constantin Finance Central Team, you will be instrumental in carrying out our ambitious Finance Roadmap along our Finance Strategy that is built upon four core pills: Value Creation, Business Partnering, Continuous Improvement, and People Development. This highly visible role blends financial process transformation with hands-on analysis, performance management, and reporting. You'll architect and execute optimized financial operations, driving robust insights, operational excellence, and value creation in collaboration with HR, Purchasing, Central Accounting, Compliance, and Group FP&A. PLAYING YOUR PART Your expertise will be instrumental in several areas: FP&A PROCESS EXCELLENCE Drive continuous improvement and foster best practices in financial planning and analysis processes to enhance collective efficiency and accuracy (e.g., Performance reporting, Purchase Order management) Development, implementation, and development robust internal controls and financial procedures, ensuring compliance and mitigating risks, and adapting to technological advances Align financials objectives with business strategy, developing scalable financial management approaches across departments and regions Support Headquarter business partners on Group reporting rules and systems CONTROLLING & REPORTING Lead and reverse the review and validation of monthly financial closures, following strictly to IFRS standards and Group policies and adoptions a hands-on approach, as well as a close working relationship with Central Accounting Preparing intelligent personnel costs reports with variance analysis and developing comparative presentations for executive decision-making (e.g., KPIs, trends, strategic recommendations) Lead regular business review meetings, discussion financial performance, forecasts, and strategic initiatives Identify optimum opportunities and foster strong partnerships with Purchasing teams for effective cost management TRANSVERSAL PROJECTS Actively contributing to and lead strategic projects focused on driving efficiency and building a robust financial infrastructure for the Maison's long-term growth WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL? Masters degree in Finance, Controlling, or Accounting +5 years of progressive experience in Finance or Corporate Controlling roles, including significant interaction with accounting shared service centers Exceptional analytical skills, capable of winning ideas and proposing adapted solutions In-depth knowledge of IFRS standards, accounting rules, and internal control frameworks, with a keep interest in technological optimization (e.g., SAP, GCP & Looker, and AI for financial insights) Excellent communication skills (French and English) and interpersonal abilities, can to translate complex data into actionable strategic recommendations Demonstrated ability to drive continuous improvement and collaboration effectively within multi-functional teams and in a dynamic, international environment Service-oriented, proactive, self-starter with a courageous and humble attitude Vacheron Constantin celebrated 270 years as the world's oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of near 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common vote to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future. If thisfires your imagination, we welcome your application. B.
